seoTitle: Styled QR Code Designer: Rounded Dots, Colors and Center Logo
metaDescription: Make a QR code with square, rounded or dot modules, rounded corner squares, your colours and an optional centre logo. Free, local SVG and PNG.
intro: Creates a QR code with module and corner styles, custom colours and an optional logo in the middle, as SVG and PNG.
why:
The plain QR Code Generator makes the standard black and white code. This one styles it. A logo covers some modules, so the tool switches to the highest error correction level (H) and caps the logo at 25 percent of the width.

A scanner needs strong contrast between dark and light, so the tool refuses colour pairs below 3:1 contrast. Styled codes were decoded back with this site's QR reader in tests, but always scan the final file with your own phone before printing.
howTo: Pick module and corner styles and the colours.
Optionally add a logo and set its size.
Run it, scan the result with your phone, then download.

faq.q: Why does the logo force level H?
faq.a: High error correction lets a scanner rebuild the covered area.

faq.q: Can I use light dots on a dark background?
faq.a: Some scanners fail inverted codes. Dark on light is safest.

faq.q: How big should it be in print?
faq.a: At least 2 cm wide for a short URL. Test with your phone.
